versions.changelog:
- Added support for all operating systems (previously Windows only).
- No other user-facing changes.

- Initial release of Google Contacts Search skill.
- Provides an atomic node to search Google Contacts using the gog binary.
- Loops internally until a successful search is achieved or a defect is detected.
- Requires COMPOSIO_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Returns results as a JSON array.
